description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Meeting held for Selecting Chairman for the Eravur Urban Council, Koralaipattu Pradeshiya Sabha and Navithanveli Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the election results and declarations of chairmen for three local authorities (Eravur Urban Council, Koralaipattu Pradeshiya Sabha, and Navithanveli Pradeshiya Sabha) following local authority elections. It specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and the declaration of elected officials, which falls under electoral processes and results - the core focus of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
